Name: funds_covered
Description: Number of funds in the Harborline universe with a latest-quarter row (one per fund). Filter by strategy region vintage or size bucket to size a custom index.

Name: total_commitments_usd_m
Description: Sum of fund sizes (total LP commitments) in USD millions.

Name: total_nav_usd_m
Description: Sum of latest net asset value attributable to LPs in USD millions.

Name: total_called_usd_m
Description: Sum of cumulative capital called from LPs (paid-in capital) in USD millions.

Name: total_distributed_usd_m
Description: Sum of cumulative distributions to LPs in USD millions.

Name: median_fund_irr_pct
Description: Median net since-inception IRR across funds in percent. The headline statistic of a custom index (the Harborline convention for fund-level comparisons).

Name: average_fund_irr_pct
Description: Simple average of fund net since-inception IRR in percent.

Name: capital_weighted_irr_pct
Description: Capital-weighted since-inception IRR in percent (weights = cumulative called capital). This is how the published Harborline indices pool constituents.

Name: pooled_tvpi
Description: Pooled total value to paid-in: sum of NAV plus distributions divided by sum of called capital. Never average fund-level TVPI.

Name: pooled_dpi
Description: Pooled distributions to paid-in: sum of distributions divided by sum of called capital.

Name: pooled_rvpi
Description: Pooled residual value to paid-in: sum of NAV divided by sum of called capital.

Name: paid_in_pct
Description: Share of commitments called so far in percent: sum of called capital over sum of fund size.

Name: funds_with_subscription_line
Description: Number of funds that use a subscription credit line (line of credit secured on LP commitments).

Name: total_credit_line_balance_usd_m
Description: Sum of subscription credit line balances drawn at the latest quarter end in USD millions.

Name: credit_line_pct_of_nav
Description: Subscription line balance as a percent of NAV (sum over sum). Above 15 percent for a single fund is the Harborline watch threshold.

Name: subscription_line_irr_gap_pts
Description: Average IRR of funds with a subscription line minus funds without at the same vintage strategy and fund age in points. Filter V_SUBSCRIPTION_LINE_IRR_GAP to a fund age (for example 8 quarters) and vintage range before using.

Name: capital_calls_usd_m
Description: Capital called from LPs in USD millions over the selected quarters (cash-flow pacing).

Name: distributions_usd_m
Description: Distributions paid to LPs in USD millions over the selected quarters (cash-flow pacing).

Name: net_cash_flow_usd_m
Description: Distributions minus capital calls in USD millions over the selected quarters; negative while a cohort is in its investment period.

Name: median_dpi_at_age
Description: Median DPI of funds at a given fund age. Filter V_CASH_FLOW_PACING_QUARTERLY to one FUND_AGE_QUARTERS value (for example 16 for four years) and compare vintages.

Name: benchmark_pooled_irr_pct
Description: Published pooled IRR of a Harborline index in percent. Always filter V_BENCHMARK_QUARTERLY to one BENCHMARK_ID one VINTAGE_COHORT and one QUARTER_END; the value is not additive.

Name: benchmark_pooled_tvpi
Description: Published pooled TVPI of a Harborline index. Filter to one index vintage cohort and quarter end.

Name: allocator_committed_usd_m
Description: Sum of an allocator's commitments to covered funds in USD millions.

Name: allocator_portfolio_irr_pct
Description: Commitment-weighted since-inception IRR of an allocator's funds in percent.

Name: allocator_benchmark_irr_pct
Description: Commitment-weighted pooled IRR of the matching Harborline benchmarks (same strategy region and vintage year as each fund) in percent.

Name: allocator_irr_gap_pts
Description: Allocator portfolio IRR minus the matching benchmark IRR in points (commitment weighted). Negative means the portfolio lags its benchmarks.

Name: extraction_match_rate
Description: Share of quarterly-report extractions whose NAV calls and distributions match the published figures within 0.5 million USD.

Name: extractions_needing_review
Description: Number of quarterly-report extractions routed to analyst review or corrected (REVIEW_STATUS not AUTO_ACCEPTED).

Name: average_extraction_confidence
Description: Average model confidence of the quarterly-report extractions (0 to 1).
